# CANDIDATE: VOLATILITY_COMPRESSION_BREAKOUT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After a period of low volatility (ATR contraction), a breakout with volume expansion captures the ensuing impulsive move. This edge exists because volatility contraction often precedes expansion, and a volume-confirmed breakout filters false signals in low-liquidity environments.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: When ATR(5) has been below 0.5 × ATR(20) for three consecutive 5‑minute bars and the price then breaks above the highest high of those three bars (for long) or below the lowest low (for short) with volume > 1.5× the average volume of the prior 20 bars, enter in the break direction at the breakout bar's close. Exit shape: Initial stop at the opposite side of the consolidation range (low of the three‑bar range for long, high for short); target at 2R or use a chandelier trail (ATR×3) trailing stop.
